text:
nora: Massive shoutout to @hassan and @mai for pulling an all-nighter and saving the sunrise demo. They tracked down the mysterious auth flake and swapped in a hotfix at 04:12am. Also — sushi delivery was an inspired move. :sushi: :heart:

hassan: thanks nora, team effort. root cause was a session cookie mismatch from a stale proxy rule. patch was a one-line fix in `auth/proxy.go` (PR #4821).

mai: rolled the hotfix, ran a targeted canary, and watched the logs till green. ps leftover sushi in kitchen B (labelled "demo survivors") if anyone's hungry. :yum:

jules: huge props to you both. bookmarking the fix for runbook. quick snippet for the playbook: ```curl -X POST https://infra.internal/reload-auth && tail -n 200 /var/log/auth.log```

ken: also want to say thanks to @nora for running the handoff and keeping the channel calm. your playlist at 3:50am was peak. :headphones: :star2:

ops-bot: Incident INC-4999 created by hassan. Severity: sev2. Assigned to infra-night. Start: 2026-03-10T04:05Z.

facilities-bot: Food log: sushi catering "SunriseRolls" delivered to Kitchen B at 2026-03-10T04:30Z. Remaining: 6 trays.

nora: tiny team tradition kick: whoever saves a demo gets to pick the office snack for the week. @hassan and @mai — what are we voting for? churros, pretzels, or matcha cookies? :question:

hassan: matcha cookies for the win. :raised_hands:

mai: churros forever. will accept both. :grin:

jules: adding this to the kudos board under "early morning heroics". thanks again all — nights like this remind me why we do this. :sparkling_heart:
